decisions.reason: Despite weaker recent visibility, this metro data centre connectivity offer matches the firm's owned-network and cloud interconnection strategy and had early adoption, so management is inclined to continue rather than admit reversal.

Optical spectrum connectivity sits close to the firm's fibre and high-bandwidth infrastructure core, and the earlier dedicated presentation creates enough public commitment that management will likely persist for another year.

The voice number ordering portal supports the announced move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning, so even without clear later evidence management can justify keeping it as part of a broader digitalisation push.

A direct voice network connection service is more exposed to legacy voice demand and less central to the firm's forward-looking integrated infrastructure agenda, so after several years of unclear traction management is now likely to cut it and reallocate resources.
